rationale: Three review lenses (blind, edge-case, acceptance) all ran cleanly. The blind lens flagged blue.300 as potentially undefined; the edge-case lens confirmed it is defined (#2297F6) and that the class text-text-accent-feedback is generated correctly by the theme system. All 6 acceptance criteria pass. Commit subjects match the project format. No security issues, no logic changes, no missed usages. The light-mode color is byte-identical to the pre-fix value.

business_review.criterion: AC-1: Like icon shows distinct blue selected state in codemieDark
business_review.notes: text-text-accent-feedback resolves to blue.300 (#2297F6) in dark mode — clearly distinct from base #FFFFFF.

business_review.criterion: AC-2: Dislike icon shows red — unchanged
AC-3: Only currently selected action is highlighted
business_review.notes: isLiked and isDisliked are mutually exclusive from the same mark state.

business_review.criterion: AC-4: Removing feedback resets icon to default
business_review.notes: deleteFeedback sets mark to empty; both booleans become false; no highlight class applied.
text-text-accent-feedback light value = blue.400 = #007AFF, same as text-text-accent light value was.

business_review.criterion: AC-6: Existing feedback submit/remove behavior unchanged
business_review.notes: No changes to handleLike, handleDislike, submitFeedback, submitLikeFeedback, or deleteFeedback.

standards_review.notes: No HTML sinks, no redirects, no secrets. Purely cosmetic.
text.accent.DEFAULT and all other existing tokens are unchanged.
